description: Unit test for the DeleteThing class, verifying immutability, JSON serialization, object creation from JSON, and equality/hash code behavior in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DeleteThingTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DeleteThing, including immutability, JSON serialization, object creation, and equality tests.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DeleteThing instances are immutable and that related objects are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies equals and hashCode implementations for DeleteThing.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a DeleteThing with a null String throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThing
methods.description: Ensures that creating a DeleteThing with a null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that toJson produces the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a DeleteThing instance from JSON and verifies its properties.
